original_description: 8 thermocouple channels of genuine measured temperatures in electrically heated aluminum rod, 26 V and 250 mA
model: tanh MLP 2 ->32 ->32 ->1 trained 600 Adam iterations; data-only and two physics-regularization strengths
physics_residual: u_t - alpha*u_xx computed at true recorded training sensor-time coordinates, coordinates nondimensional; external heating/loss not fully represented
interpretation: Physics regularization degraded held-out prediction in this experiment. Unknown heat-source boundary and convective losses preclude interpreting learned nondimensional alpha as measured aluminum thermal diffusivity.
status: authentic observed dataset and local 600-epoch model execution verified; complete raw numeric output in local archival package; clean-checkout GitHub Actions and manuscript integration pending
